title: What God Starts, He Finishes
summary: He knew us, chose us and called us before we ever called on him. Having done nothing to save ourselves, should we start depending on ourselves now?
exhortation: What we see here is that what God starts, he finishes. For those of us who are still in process, which is all of us, that is great news.

When we look to ourselves, we either fall into discouragement at our lack of progress and fear about the future, or, if things are going well, we pridefully think we've got this, and put ourselves on the most dangerous path a Christian can take.

But when we look to Jesus, we see that he knew us long before we knew him. He predestined us for salvation long before we saw our need, and he called us long before we ever thought to call out to him. His blood bought our freedom before we even knew we were in debt. So should we now doubt that he will bring us to a glorious completion? Having done nothing to save ourselves, should we now start depending on ourselves? No. What Jesus starts, he will complete.
So what are we to do? Love God. Look at what he has done, and let your heart be filled with gratitude, praise, worship and a growing love for Jesus.
prayer: Lord, we are grateful that you have paid it all. We don't come by our works or claiming anything of our own. We claim the blood of Jesus Christ, the fountain of every blessing, and we fall on our knees before you.
We are so grateful this morning. May we remember your gospel and the work Christ has accomplished.
